page.notes: Arabic words are copied from the scan and may be inexact: "ترهّب" (after Ammanum), the Arabic phrase "من اشتهر ملكه و عرفت ممالكه" in the citation, and "ظفار" after Tafaro are uncertain and marked [?]. "عدن" after Adane is read with less doubt. "Philoflorgium" and "Praeposito" are copied as printed; the printer's forms may be errors. Long s is rendered as s throughout, including "Yusef". Only specks and the faint margin rule are visible in the right margin, and they are not text.
